title: SoIC_H Technology for Heterogenous System Integration
venue: 2022 IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits, pp. 258-259
orgs: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd (Pathfinding for System Integration)
notes: TSMC SoIC_H: SoIC bond (3-9 um pitch) replaces microbump on 5-metal Si interposer; measured interposer lines to 40 GHz; STCO D2D, fanout, 4-Hi SRAM, 12-Hi HBM.

title: Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge (EMIB) -- A High Density, High Bandwidth Packaging Interconnect
notes: Overview: bridge attributes (Table II), process flow, 55/130 um bump pitch, measured S-params of bridge trace pair (80 samples), simulated eye-width envelope.

title: Process Development and Performance Benefits of 0.64-0.36 μm Pitch Hybrid Bonding on Intel Process
notes: W2W hybrid bonding test chip, dual damascene bond layer, 0.64/0.48/0.36 um pitch; AFM 1-2 nm pad height, <1% voids, normalized daisy-chain R only. Few absolute dimensions.

title: Advancing Interconnect Performance and Reliability with Innovations in 3D Photonic Integration Packaging and Fiber Coupling
technology_name: Passage M1000 (Passage M Series 3D Silicon Photonics Engine)
notes: 15 ASIC chiplets CoW on TSV photonic interposer (4 stitched tiles), 7200 mm2 organic substrate, lid, 8 edge-attached PM FAUs (128 fibers); TTV, warpage, solder heights, IL, BER, 900 W thermal.

title: Glass-Stacked Interposers with Microdispensed Silver Nanopaste for Low-Temperature 3D Interconnection
notes: Borosilicate slide + 150 um coverslips, fs-laser vias (400 um design), microdispensed US-202A traces, CL83A via fill/interlayer adhesive; resistivity, via R, tape test.
